_comment: The first ten minutes (docs/FIXES.md, 7). opening: the cards shown once, before play first begins in a valley; each is a few lines, in the script's voice (the Unity repo's docs/DESIGN.md: the Event, the player, the discovery), and all of them can be skipped. goals: the first things to do, shown on screen one at a time in this order; each is done when its flag is set (by doing the thing, in any order). After them the screen shows the next step of the milestone in hand. hints: one-line lessons said once, when they are first needed.
opening:
Eight years since the bombs and the sickness.
You were an engineer once. You had a family once.
You have been walking ever since.

Yesterday raiders ran you into a canyon with no way out.
You dove under a waterfall to get away from their guns,
and a current pulled you sideways, into the rock.

You came up in the greenest place you have ever seen.
Someone built a home in its cliff, and never came back.
Nothing out there can reach you here. This valley is yours now.

goals.text: You are hungry. Choose the tinned food (keys 1–9 or the wheel) and right-click to eat
You are thirsty. Choose the water jug and right-click to drink (or right-click any water with an empty hand)
Read the builder’s journal and his handbooks: right-click the bookshelves in the cave behind you
Find the armory: the chest in the vault, through the hall at the back of the cave
Sleep in the builder’s bed, through the double door on the cave’s south side (from five in the evening): you wake there from then on
The way out: down the path at the balcony’s north end, across the valley, and dive under the waterfall. The tunnel is lit

hints.hungry: Hungry. Put food in your hand (keys 1–9 or the wheel) and right-click to eat. There is more in the pantry, and the garden grows it.
hints.thirsty: Thirsty. Right-click any water with an empty hand, or drink from a jug in your hand.
hints.safeWrong: Not that. The builder wrote the day down in his journal: four digits, the month first.
hints.noSky: This array is under rock or a roof: it makes nothing. Set it under open sky, at home.
hints.smoker: A smoker. Put raw meat in it (right-click): by the next watch of the day it is smoked, and keeps.
hints.jerky_rack: A jerky rack. Hang raw meat on it (right-click): it is cured by morning.
hints.hutch: A hutch. Put two live rabbits in it (right-click): they breed each morning. Snares in the buffer catch them.
